precepts.instruction: Use only known locations and objects, or explicitly flag missing world knowledge.
A usual location is not a confirmed current location; plans must use detection before grasping.
Use detect_person or detect_object with appropriate attributes rather than inventing new perception actions.
Every action must belong to the eight-action vocabulary. Validate before returning.
Only plan; do not claim any physical action occurred.

precepts.name: return_to_instruction_point
precepts.when: A GPSR task requires reporting results or delivering an object
precepts.then: Navigate to gpsr_instruction_point before reporting or delivering the object
